title.quote: NovoMolGen: Rethinking Molecular Language Model Pretraining
title.justification: Title as written on the paper
title.value: NovoMolGen: Rethinking Molecular Language Model Pretraining

extractions.description: The paper introduces NovoMolGen, a family of Llama-architecture decoder-only transformer models (32M, 157M, 300M) pretrained on 1.5B molecules from ZINC-22 in SMILES, SELFIES, SAFE and DeepSMILES representations with atomwise and BPE tokenization. It studies the effect of representation, tokenization, model size and dataset scale on unconstrained generation metrics (validity, FCD, novelty, etc.) and on downstream goal-directed tasks (PMO benchmark, protein-ligand docking) using a REINVENT-style reinforcement learning fine-tuning with top-k sampling and experience replay.
